claims.content: To investigate and resolve customer inquiries regarding auction bids, orders, and account activity by accessing relevant reports and data.

goal.raw_text: To investigate and resolve customer inquiries regarding auction bids, orders, and account activity by accessing relevant reports and data.

claims.content: Customer Service Representative
The Customer Service Representative must be logged into the Auction Administration system.
The 'Customer Ranking Report' or 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' mockups must be accessible within the administration interface to view customer data and auction details.
A customer contacts the Customer Service Representative with an inquiry regarding their auction bids, orders, or account activity.

trigger.raw_text: A customer contacts the Customer Service Representative with an inquiry regarding their auction bids, orders, or account activity.

claims.content: The Customer Service Representative navigates to the 'Auction Admin Main Menu Page'.
The representative selects the 'Customer Ranking Report' or 'Inventory Performance & Aging Report' from the main menu options.
The system displays the report interface, allowing the representative to filter data by criteria such as 'Order Date', 'Retail Category', 'Prod Type', or 'Gemstone'.
The representative enters specific search parameters related to the customer's inquiry (e.g., Member ID, Email Address, or Auction Item details) and submits the query.

The system generates a detailed view showing relevant metrics such as 'Total Items Bid On', 'Gross Winnings', 'Cancelled Orders', 'Return Rate', and 'Net Kept Units' for the selected customer or inventory items.
The representative reviews the displayed data to identify the status of bids, orders, or inventory aging issues causing the inquiry.
The representative uses the gathered information to address and resolve the customer's inquiry.
If the customer inquiry is related to specific item details or auction creation, the representative may navigate to the 'Create New Auctions Page' instead of a report.

If the initial search in the report yields no results, the representative can adjust the filter criteria, such as changing the 'Order Date', 'Retail Category', or 'Gemstone' selections, and resubmit the query.
If the inquiry requires checking general site navigation or customer-facing page status, the representative may consult the 'Site Diagram' to verify page availability or structure.
If the search query returns no results, the system displays a 'No Results Search Page' or an empty data grid, requiring the representative to adjust filters.
If the customer inquiry involves an item that is not available for auction (e.g., missing image or location), the report will flag this status, potentially preventing standard resolution steps.
If the representative attempts to access restricted administrative functions without proper permissions, the system denies access via the 'User Access Mgmt Page' controls.
The Customer Service Representative has successfully identified the status of the customer's bids, orders, or account activity based on the report data.
The specific metrics related to the inquiry (such as 'Total Items Bid On', 'Gross Winnings', 'Cancelled Orders', or 'Auction Available' status) have been retrieved and reviewed.
The representative possesses the necessary information to address the customer's inquiry regarding auction performance or inventory aging.
